hing_jeera.name: Hing-Jeera
hing_jeera.method: Heat 1 tsp oil or ghee. Add 1 tsp cumin seeds; when they sizzle and darken slightly, add a pinch of hing. Pour over the dish straight away.

lehsun_lal_mirch.name: Lehsun-Lal Mirch
lehsun_lal_mirch.method: Heat 1 tsp oil. Add 3 sliced garlic cloves and 2 dry red chillies; stir until the garlic turns golden, not brown. Pour over the dish straight away.

mustard_curry_leaf.name: Mustard-Curry Leaf
mustard_curry_leaf.method: Heat 1 tsp oil. Add 1 tsp mustard seeds; when they pop, add a sprig of curry leaves (stand back, they splutter). Pour over the dish straight away.

panch_phoron.name: Panch Phoron
panch_phoron.method: Heat 1 tsp mustard oil until it just starts to smoke, then lower the heat. Add 1 tsp panch phoron; when the seeds crackle, pour over the dish straight away.
